Package org.geysermc.paletter.block.component

Record Class DestructibleByMining

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.block.component.DestructibleByMining
Record Components:
baseTimeToDestroy - Sets the number of server simulation ticks it takes to mine the block with base equipment. Greater numbers result in greater mining times. A negative number means the block can't be mined. Add-on JSON base_time_to_destroy. Default: 0.
itemSpecificSpeeds - Optional array of objects to describe item specific block destroy speeds, each object contains an 'item' ItemDescriptor and a 'destroy_speed' float. Optional array of objects to describe item specific block destroy speeds, each object contains an 'item' ItemDescriptor and a 'destroy_speed' float. This array currently requires UpcomingFeatures experiment to be enabled. Add-on JSON item_specific_speeds. Optional (null: not set).
secondsToDestroy - Sets the number of seconds it takes to destroy the block with base equipment. Greater numbers result in greater mining times. Add-on JSON seconds_to_destroy. Default: 0. Range [0, inf) (BDS 1.26.63.1).
enabled - The boolean form of the component (add-on JSON {@code "minecraft:destructible_by_mining": <boolean>}). Optional (null: not set).
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent
@BedrockFormat("1.21.50") public record DestructibleByMining(float baseTimeToDestroy, @Nullable List<DestructibleByMining.ItemSpecificSpeeds> itemSpecificSpeeds, float secondsToDestroy, @Nullable Boolean enabled) extends Record implements BlockComponent
Describes the destructible by mining properties for this block. If set to true, the block will take the default number of seconds to destroy. If set to false, this block is indestructible by mining. If the component is omitted, the block will take the default number of seconds to destroy.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:destructible_by_mining". Compiled by the hand transform destructible_by_mining (see data/model/transforms.json).

Since:
1.0.0
